claims.text: The RSFSR Supreme Soviet enacts that the state Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (RSFSR) is henceforth to be called the Russian Federation (Russia), a name to be used in official acts, in state symbols and in the names of state bodies; the former names may be used in official paperwork (forms, seals and stamps) during 1992; a draft law amending the Constitution and the Declaration of State Sovereignty is to be put to the Congress of People's Deputies; the law enters into force on the day of its adoption, 25 December 1991.
claims.uncertainty: A renaming of the RSFSR, not a succession from the USSR and not an act of a USSR organ. Adoption and entry into force fall on the same day under point 5. The constitutional amendment it asks the Congress to adopt was not reviewed.

claims.text: The portal text prints the signature block 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин, Москва, Дом Советов России, 25 декабря 1991 года, № 2094-I'.
claims.uncertainty: Published text only. The signed GARF original (ru_garf_law_2094i_original_19911225) reads 'Президент РСФСР' and 'Дом Советов РСФСР'. The published title is not evidence of the title under which the law was signed, and neither form is used as a holder observation.

scope_note: The renaming law; it is why the RSFSR presidency is filed in this packet. Gazette citation: Vedomosti 1992 No. 2, art. 62. Its published signature title differs from the signed original (see ru_garf_exhibit_law_2094i).
